runtime.checkPreviewUi: ability page renders slug.check and slug.preview as availability, conflict, URL and warning tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.repairResultUi: ability page renders slug.repair as bounded summary and per-content repair tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.routeRulePreview: ability page explains slug route prefix, dynamic pattern, sample URL and preview result without request hot-path checks
runtime.ruleConflictExplain: exact static routes win before slug dynamic route; prefix risks are surfaced at submit/preview time
runtime.crossAbilityRuleCheck: ability page compares slug and redirect dynamic prefixes without adding request hot-path checks
runtime.unifiedRulePlan: ability page includes slug, redirect and static rule sources in one admin-time route rule plan
runtime.routeRulePlanApi: admin route-rule.plan returns the unified route plan when slug, redirect or static packs are enabled
runtime.routeRuleValidateApi: admin route-rule.validate includes slug prefix risk and cross-ability prefix conflict warnings without request hot-path checks
runtime.routeRuleListApi: admin route-rule.list exposes slug route snapshots inside the unified URL rule management page
runtime.routeRuleStatsApi: admin route-rule.stats returns read-only aggregate counts from the unified URL rule snapshot table
runtime.routeRuleRefreshApi: admin route-rule.refresh rewrites the unified URL rule snapshot table on demand and returns bounded sync counts
runtime.routeRulePlanUi: ability page renders the unified URL rule plan as route source and static rule tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.routeRuleValidateUi: ability page renders bounded URL rule validation warnings as a table without request hot-path checks
runtime.routeRuleStatsUi: ability page renders unified URL rule snapshot stats by pack and rule type
runtime.routeRuleRefreshUi: ability page renders route-rule.refresh as before/synced/after counts while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.independentRouteRuleStore: route-rule plan/validate persist current slug/redirect/static rule snapshots to content_route_rule only when related packs are enabled
runtime.historyLimit: admin slug history clamps request limit by maxHistoryRows
runtime.publicLookupLimit: slug public/detail lookup clamps payload scan by maxPublicLookupRows
runtime.physicalSlugColumn: enabled pack migrates content_item.slug_value and indexes new writes while preserving payload fallback for old rows
runtime.repairLimit: admin slug repair clamps batch size by maxRepairRows
runtime.requestLimit: admin slug repair rejects request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.categoryBindIntegration: detail and slug.resolve responses prefer content_category_bind categoryId when content.category is enabled
runtime.accessIntegration: slug.resolve hides restricted content through content.access when that pack is enabled
